stem_book: If a₁, a₂, a₃, …, aₙ are positive real numbers whose product is a fixed number c, then find the minimum value of a₁ + a₂ + a₃ + … + aₙ₋₁ + 2aₙ.
reason: Print says 'real numbers' and 'a₁ + a₂ + a₃ + … + 2aₙ' with no n; corrected to n positive reals (AM-GM needs positivity)
work: AM-GM on a₁, …, aₙ₋₁, 2aₙ (product 2c): sum ≥ n(2c)^(1/n)
